items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Don recorded 4 numbers with a band that included ... Bob Ysaguire, bass

ctx.x: the band also. I was one of those whom Don wanted. He must have remembered me from the time when Scott's band had played a dance in Pittsburg with the Cotton Pickers and had asked who I was.

Don recorded 4 numbers with a band that included Leonard 'Ham' Davis, Red Allen and myself on trumpet, Claude Jones, Fred Robinson and Benny Morton, trombones, Edward Inge, clarinet and alto, Rupert Cole, alto, Bob Carroll, tenor, Horace Henderson, piano, Talcot Reeves, guitar, Manzie Johnson, drums, Bob Ysaguire, bass, Lois Deppe and Don, vocals. The titles were 'Chant of the Weed ', 'Shaking the African ', 'I Heard' and

The only trumpet solos were done by Red Allen and when these records came out with the names of the musicians, Langston Curl's name was on the cover instead of Bill Coleman. It probably happened because I never joined Don's band before.
